{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = real_orders[(real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (real_orders['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_parsed'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue for loyal completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Confirm the sample
print("Sample of parsed revenue for loyal completed (real orders only):")
print(loyal_completed['revenue_parsed'].head())"}
